definitions.ask: Which authenticated path should the Mac's Postfix use to deliver cron mail?
definitions.why: Reuses athena's existing Mailjet relay and SPF record; adds no new credential

choices.label: Relay via athena's Mailjet smarthost over the tailnet; no new secret, needs athena up
Send via smtp.gmail.com with an app password stored on Kelly's laptop; no athena dependency

definitions.ask: Should the Mac's network-supplied hostname be fixed so cronctl can manage its crontab again?
definitions.why: HostName is unset, so the name follows the network; pinning removes the cause

choices.label: Pin HostName to Kellys-MacBook-Pro.local in the Mac sudo batch; name stops following DHCP
Add Kellys-MBP to cron.machines.mac; no sudo, but a new network name breaks it again
Leave it; cronctl keeps reporting mac as identity_mismatch and refuses to apply
